summary: WCB functionality manages and records student Workers Compensation Board (WCB) statuses, waivers, dates, and related business rules for safety and compliance tracking. It integrates into the larger StudentPrerequisite workflow, which governs student immunizations, health records, and compliance requirements.
purpose: To ensure accurate tracking and updating of student WCB status, waivers, and any exceptions related to safety compliance in educational or healthcare placements.

workflows.name: StudentDetailsSafetyWCBUpdate
steps: Staff submits WCB waiver date and notes for a student.
WCB status code and waiver details are saved in the database.
StaffID and SessionID are recorded for audit.

workflows.name: StudentPrerequisitesSearch
steps: System retrieves student’s WCB status, waiver date, and notes as part of overall student prerequisites.
Validations are applied to ensure dates are within allowed ranges.

business_rules: WCBStatusCodeID must be specified when updating WCB status.
WCBWaiverDate must be a valid date.
WCBWaiverNotes are optional but recommended for context.
WCB waiver date cannot be before the current date.
If a student does not have a WCB waiver, system assumes compliance by other means.
validations: Date fields (WCBWaiverDate) must be valid and not in the past.
If WCB waiver years specified, expiry date must be present.
Expiry date must be on or after the completed date.
conditions: If WCBStatusCodeID = 0, WCBWaiverDate should remain empty.
If WaiverDate is specified, WCBStatusCodeID must be present.
If waiver is expired, display a warning.
system_behavior: Automatically formats waiver dates for display.
Adds error messages if waiver date is invalid or missing.
Records StaffID and SessionID for all WCB status updates.
exceptions: WCB waiver date more than 5 years in the future triggers error.
Missing WCBStatusCodeID when waiver date entered triggers error.
Invalid or missing dates will prevent updates.
content_gaps: No visible UI sample for WCB status entry screen.
No explicit list of values for WCBStatusCode.
No sample error messages in English (referenced as Resources).
Context of WCB in relation to other prerequisite modules is not fully detailed.
